benchmarks.task_description:
fix(deps): move url to 2.5.9 and cookie to 0.18.3, which fix RUSTSEC-2026-0592 and RUSTSEC-2026-0594

## What changed

Two new advisories fail the advisories check on main, so every PR's licenses job fails.

- RUSTSEC-2026-0592: url 2.5.8 could overflow the stack in `Url::origin()` on a URL nested in many `blob:` prefixes. url 2.5.9 fixes it. url comes in through reqwest.
- RUSTSEC-2026-0594: cookie 0.18.2 could repeat a private cookie's nonce in a process that forks. cookie 0.18.3 fixes it. cookie comes in through tauri, tauri-runtime and wry in the desktop app.

url 2.5.9 needs form_urlencoded 1.2.3. sx-llm pins form_urlencoded exactly, so that pin moves from 1.2.2 to 1.2.3 in packages/pilot/llm/Cargo.toml. Cargo.lock changes cookie, url and form_urlencoded only.

## Testing

- cargo deny check licenses bans sources advisories: on main, advisories FAILED with these two errors only; on this branch, advisories ok, bans ok, licenses ok, sources ok.
- cargo check --workspace --locked: clean (url, cookie, form_urlencoded, sx-llm, sx-cloud, tauri, wry and slicerx-desktop all built).
- cargo metadata --locked: clean.
- cargo test -p sx-llm -p sx-connect: 449 passed, 0 failed, in 12 test binaries.

benchmarks.task_description:
fix(deploy): write validation summary after the dataset scan

## What does this change?

Writes the `pnpm validate --json` summary to `/tmp/validation.json` and moves it into the dataset directory only after validation succeeds, instead of teeing directly into `$DATA_DIR`.

## Why?

The first deploy of the recorded-validation change failed: `tee` created an empty `$DATA_DIR/validation.json` before `validatePaths` scanned the directory, so validation read its own empty output and reported `invalid JSON (Unexpected end of JSON input)`. Writing outside the scanned tree fixes the ordering, and `set -o pipefail` still fails the step on a real validation error before the move.

## Type

- [ ] Data correction or package addition
- [ ] Engine / rules change (methodology)
- [x] Pipeline, CI or security
- [ ] Site, docs or accessibility
- [ ] Bug fix

## Evidence

- Reproduced the deploy ordering locally: direct tee into the dataset fails, temp-file-then-move passes.
- Simulated deploy directory: `pnpm validate /tmp/sg-deploy` exits `0` with `validation.json` present.
- Site build from that directory renders `passed at 2026-11-27T13:21:14.703Z over 1 target(s) (0 problem(s))`.
- The failing deploy run is 46006221834; its log shows the empty `validation.json` read.

## Checklist

- [x] `pnpm typecheck` passes
- [x] `pnpm test` passes
- [x] `pnpm validate registry fixtures` passes
- [x] Docs updated (README, METHODOLOGY or ADR) where behaviour changed
- [x] No secrets, tokens or package source committed
- [ ] Breaking change? Migration described below

## Screenshots (site changes only)

Not applicable; workflow ordering fix.

benchmarks.task_description:
Lint: four exhaustive-deps warnings fixed in the charts and LoopEdge; at most 75 warnings

Part of #625 (item 5, the third rule-by-rule follow-up; the item stays open). Scope set by Lumi: the four `exhaustive-deps` warnings confirmed in the two charts and `LoopEdge`.

**This step fixes 4 of the 11 `exhaustive-deps` warnings. The rule stays a warning until all of them are gone. 7 remain: `TimelineChart:159` and the 6 in `Canvas`.**

## What changes

| Where | Warning | Fix | What the app does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `TimetableRateChart.tsx:88` (2) | the polyline memo used `toTime`, which reads `stepSec`, and listed `stepSec` | it computes with `stepSec` and `unitSec` directly, and lists both | the same: it recomputes on the same inputs |
| `edges/LoopEdge.tsx:585` | the label-size effect read `label.unit` without listing it | `label.unit` is listed | the same: `labelKey`, already listed, contains `label.unit`, so no run is added |
| `TimelineChart.tsx:185` | the view-floor effect read `height` without listing it, on purpose: "the switch alone decides; a resize inside the view is the splitter's" | the body is a `useEffectEvent`, which reads the latest height; the effect still lists only `[floorWanted, isMobile]` | the same: it runs only when the view switches, with the height of that render |

- `.oxlintrc.json`: `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` stays `warn`, its comment now 11 → 7.
- `package.json`: `--max-warnings 79` → **75**. README updated. `.changes`: internal.

## Not changed: `TimelineChart.tsx:159`

- An effect with no dependency list, on purpose: it measures the page after every render, and sets state only when a number changes, so it cannot loop.
- A list of dependencies would mean it no longer measures every render. So it stays a warning, with its comment saying why.
- An alternative, such as measuring on a `ResizeObserver`, waits for a test of what it does.

**Why not a suppression comment.** Tried and taken out: with `// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` on that effect, four other warnings in the same component also disappeared, `refs` 1 and `set-state-in-effect` 3. Taking the comment out brought them back. A `react-hooks` suppression stops the compiler-based rules for the whole component, so it would hide that component's other findings.

The suppressions already in the code hide warnings the same way: 18, found in five files. They count toward #625 item 5 and are recorded there; they are fixed one by one later, not in this pull request.

## Results

- Warnings left: **75**.
  - `only-export-components` 30;
  - correctness 45: `set-state-in-effect` 23, `refs` 15, `exhaustive-deps` 7.
- `npm run lint` exits 0. `scripts/lint-policy.test.mjs` (6) passes with the cap of 75.

## Related e2e (`--workers=1 --retries=0`): **411 passed, 0 failed**

- 27 specs:
  - for the charts and the chip: `timeline-*` (11), `timetable-*` (4), `distribution-area`, `distribution-export-dismiss`, `monte-carlo`, `mc-paths`, `mc-invalidation`, `run-guide`, `chip-unit`, `label-timing`, `edge-routing`;
  - the screenshot specs `large-graph-readability`, `i18n-visual` and `mobile`.
- Screenshots were compared against the baselines: no differences, none updated.
- The hashes of the three components and the 27 specs were identical before and after.

## Checks

Every `check:*` script passes. `npx tsc -b` is clean. `npx vitest run`: 5884 passed, 4 skipped; the component tests (370) were also run on their own.
